messages.subject: impossible to find function "revalue"
parts:
Hi,
I try to get accustomed with deducer (latest version) and started with a most basic Plot > Quick > Bar with an integer variable with the name of Ethnic.cleansing

> ggplot() +
+ geom_bar(aes(y = ..count..,x = as.factor(ethnic.cleansing)),data=zsf.EU.27.export.Haller.data)

I get the following error (retranslated from French):

Error in rename(x, .base_to_ggplot, warn_missing = FALSE) :
impossible to find function "revalue".

What does that mean ? How to treat the error ?

Any help appreciated

TIA
